model: DeepTrace joint variant (CLIP ViT-B/32 + MLP head)
protocol: Train on joint mode (DeepTrace-GV + Celeb-DF v2) excluding held-out generator. Test on held-out generator fake clips + real test clips.

summary.note: Test sets are 24-26 clips per round. Results are exploratory, not statistically robust. Veo is consistently the hardest generator to detect.
